About Lessy

I’m Lessy, a software developer and WordPress specialist. My full name is Finehas Lesiamon Mpoe, but nearly everyone calls me Lessy, and that’s the name to look for.

What I do at Prospergenics

I’m a co-founder, trainer and software developer at Prospergenics, a software and AI development team across the Netherlands and Kenya. I work alongside Martien de Jong, our fellow co-founder and mentor, and with fellow developers Frank, Diko and Sandra. We build software and teach practical development skills. You can find my profile on the Prospergenics team page.

What I’m best at

WordPress is my strongest skill: custom themes, Elementor and complete business websites. More and more of my time goes into workflow automations, AI agents and reusable skills for those agents, joining up interfaces, APIs and tools.

How I got here

I started with WordPress sites, then picked up Angular, Node.js, Python and Flask, and more recently C#, PHP and n8n. I’m still learning, and I like it that way. Before the client work there was plenty of practice: 87 coursework repositories on my GitHub.

Work you can look at

The projects page lists everything I’ve built, from the ReNa Farm website and management app to the VloerBot AI assistant and the Jengo family of AI tools.
